name: Jan Despanie
source:
The owner and chef of the tavern Rocking Boat. He is a former pirate and often brags about his adventures.

"...is a pirate. He cooks stuff, and owns a pub, but does that really matter? PIRATE, folks!"

[Based on [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20061018090801/http://community.hirameki-int.com/modules/charpoll5/index.php?id=1]Hirameki's Official Site[/url] (Website is via webarchive)]
